about: Prose input + choice questions (first designed in the playground, then tuned with tools/proseprobe.mjs, tools/dirprobe.mjs and headless flights). One /v1/systemone call per decision with all questions; state = perception prose: where the pad is (side stated twice), drift toward/away from it, altitude/descent, terrain clearance toward the pad. pad_choice is asked in its own call in the pads layout.

flight_direction.instructions: Determine whether to fly to the right or to the left to get over the pad

criteria.right: fly to the right, toward the pad that is off to your right
criteria.left: fly to the left, toward the pad that is off to your left
criteria.none: no need to fly left or right because you are directly above the pad

flight_velocity.instructions: Determine how fast to fly sideways based on how far off the pad is

criteria.fast: fly fast if the pad is far off or way in the distance
criteria.slow: fly slowly if the pad is a fair way off
criteria.very_slow: fly very slowly if the pad is close, just off to one side
criteria.none: no sideways speed needed if you are directly above the pad

downward_thrust_magnitude.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander. Determine the magnitude of the thrust needed to slow the descent of the lander based on its altitude.

criteria.large: a lot of thrust is needed because the lander has low altitude and is descending very fast
criteria.medium: some thrust is needed because the lander has low altitude and is descending slowly, or the pad is still far away and the lander is getting low, or a ridge ahead is higher than the lander
criteria.small: very little thrust is needed because the lander is descending slowly or has high altitude
criteria.none: no thrust is needed because the lander is not descending

question.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander and must choose which landing pad to aim for. Weigh the reward points against the risk: how far the pad is, how much fuel is left, and how hard the pad is to land on. A pad that is higher than you or behind a ridge costs a lot of fuel to reach. When fuel is low, choose the nearest pad you can reach. Keep heading for the current pad unless another pad is clearly better.

criteria.narrow: the narrow pad: ×2 points, a good choice when it is near and there is enough fuel
criteria.wide: the wide pad: ×1 points, the safe choice when the other pads are far or hard to reach
criteria.ridge: the ridge pad: ×3 points, worth it only with plenty of fuel when it is near and not higher than you
